sftp polling.mulesoft: SFTP Connector: On New or Updated File (listener) with watermark
sftp polling.wso2: WSO2 Micro Integrator: VFS inbound endpoint (transport.vfs.*) on an sftp:// URL

idempotent handling.mulesoft: Idempotent Message Validator with an Object Store
idempotent handling.wso2: Mediation sequence with a Cache/DataService lookup on a message key (no built-in idempotent EIP)

edi parsing.camel: Hand-rolled parser or an EDI data format
edi parsing.wso2: Smooks mediator or a Ballerina EDI tool, mapped with the Data Mapper

channel fallback.camel: Dead-letter channel / onException with a next-endpoint route
channel fallback.mulesoft: Try scope with On Error Continue, then a flow-ref to the next channel
channel fallback.wso2: Fault sequence plus a failover endpoint (failover group)
